_about: The owner's title layers (canvas 1280x1200 = the screen at 5x; scaled to 10x at build time). Positions = top-left of each layer on the canvas; drawn back to front in this order. *_sunset layers may get *_day versions; without them the day look is recoloured at build time. template.png is the owner's composite of all layers.
